messages.subject: Re: Plotting quarterly data
parts:
Carlos,

This is a pretty general question...googling "ggplot date axis"
produces a whole bunch of things to read and tutorials to follow, a
useful place to start. Basically, I think you're going to want to make
sure your date variable is in "POSIXct", the date format understood by
ggplot, and go from there. If you'd like a more specific answer, send
some sample data.

Kind regards
Ben
